description: This file defines an analytics endpoint using Flask for a backend service. It includes a schema for the analytics summary and a Flask MethodView that provides a GET endpoint to retrieve total counts of users, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and quiz submissions from a database via a Supabase client.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummarySchema
classes.description: A Marshmallow schema defining the structure of the analytics summary response, including total counts for users, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and quiz submissions.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummary
classes.description: A Flask MethodView handling the '/summary' endpoint, returning aggregate analytics data.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve aggregated analytics counts, querying the database through the Supabase client.

ctags.name: app
ctags.pattern: /^from flask import current_app as app, jsonify$/

ctags.name: assignments
ctags.pattern: /^    assignments = fields.Integer(required=True, description="Total number of assignments")$/

ctags.name: lessons
ctags.pattern: /^    lessons = fields.Integer(required=True, description="Total number of lessons")$/

ctags.name: quiz_submissions
ctags.pattern: /^    quiz_submissions = fields.Integer(required=True, description="Total number of quiz submissio/

ctags.name: quizzes
ctags.pattern: /^    quizzes = fields.Integer(required=True, description="Total number of quizzes")$/

ctags.name: users
ctags.pattern: /^    users = fields.Integer(required=True, description="Total number of users (profiles)")$/
